evidence.quoted_text:
if git(root, 'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all') != ' M ' + CONFIG:
            raise ValueError('post-switch status must contain only rendered config')
evidence.reason: In `switch`, `destination` is rendered from the overlay against `target`, then after `git checkout --detach target` it is written to the config path. If the rendered config is byte-identical to the target commit's committed config, the write leaves no working-tree change and `git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all` returns an empty string. The post-switch check requires exactly `' M ' + CONFIG`, so it raises even though the switch and write succeeded. Accepting either empty status or the single unstaged `CONFIG` modification is the smallest compatible fix and still rejects any other change.
